description: This file defines the class 'HTMLPurifier_Strategy_RemoveForeignElements', which implements a strategy for removing or transforming unrecognized or foreign HTML tags within an HTML purification library. The class contains an 'execute' method that processes tokens, validates tags and attributes, handles comments, and removes or transforms elements as per configuration settings.

classes.name: HTMLPurifier_Strategy_RemoveForeignElements
classes.description: Implements a strategy to remove or transform unrecognized foreign elements in HTML content based on configuration settings.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Processes a list of HTML tokens, removing or transforming unrecognized tags, comments, and related elements based on configuration options.
